status: curated, source-dated evidence anchors for conditional 2027-2031 strategy; not a systematic literature review or future prediction

sources.title: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2026 — named coding agents/assistants
sources.finding: Claude Code 65.5%, Copilot 58.7%, Codex 29.5% of n=12,255 named-tool question respondents reporting use in preceding year; multi-select.
sources.caveat: Self-selected, question-specific denominator. Not population-wide adoption, usage intensity or causal impact.

sources.title: Stack Overflow 2026 developer survey methodology
sources.caveat: Community outreach, no global developer probability sample.

sources.title: METR: We are Changing our Developer Productivity Experiment Design
sources.finding: AI uplift experiments face selective task entry/refusal, concurrent-agent accounting and tooling change; no reliable universal contemporaneous speedup magnitude
sources.caveat: Original 19%-longer early 2025 result was specific to experienced OSS tasks and then-available tools.

sources.title: DORA State of AI-assisted Software Development (2025)
sources.finding: AI acts as amplifier depending on organizational fundamentals
sources.caveat: Survey/organization correlations and versioned errata, not a universal randomized causal effect.

sources.title: DORA: Balancing AI tensions
sources.finding: Higher adoption associated with throughput gains and instability; generation savings can migrate to verification/review
sources.caveat: Organizational association; avoid claiming a task-level causal rate.

sources.title: GitHub Octoverse 2025
sources.finding: Platform-defined AI-related repository and activity increase
sources.caveat: AI-related application != confirmed agent-authored source or actual user usefulness.

sources.title: GitHub Trending
sources.finding: Observed page membership, rank, filter, label at specific UTC capture
sources.caveat: Opaque selection/ranking, not a software quality, adoption or carbon score.

sources.title: ISO/IEC 21031:2024 SCI
sources.finding: Software carbon intensity method with operational + embodied per functional unit
sources.caveat: Requires coherent source boundary, measured or calibrated E/I/M, not automatic token-to-emissions factor.

sources.title: GSF Software Carbon Intensity for AI
sources.finding: AI lifecycle provider/consumer boundaries and appropriate functional units
sources.caveat: Transparent full data may be unavailable for black-box commercial API usage; report partial bounds.

sources.title: OpenSSF Scorecard
sources.finding: Automated security process signals for OSS
sources.caveat: Not proof that a candidate has no vulnerabilities or matches task semantics.

sources.title: NIST TREC overview and judgment method
sources.finding: Independent relevance judgments and documented benchmark protocols
sources.caveat: Retrieval-pool incompleteness prevents claiming global absolute recall.

sources.title: Census III public library study
sources.finding: Operational dependence on OSS libraries and associated maintainer/security issues
sources.caveat: Specific production dependency instrumentation is not a random sample of all software.
